title: Fed Chair Warsh Makes Jackson Hole Debut; Markets Brace for Rate Signals
summary: Kevin Warsh delivers his first keynote as Federal Reserve Chair at the Kansas City Fed's Jackson Hole symposium. Markets are watching for hints on rate policy ahead of the September 16 FOMC meeting. 30-year Treasury yields recently touched 5.31%, the highest since 2007.
why: Warsh首次以美联储主席身份在杰克逊霍尔发言，将为9月FOMC定调。若释放鹰派信号，美债收益率进一步走高将压缩高估值科技股，并推高期权隐含波动率——影响sell-put策略的风险回报比。

title: Nvidia Posts Record $96.2B Quarter, Up 106% YoY; Guides $108B Next Quarter
summary: Nvidia reported Q2 FY2027 revenue of $96.2 billion, up 106% year-over-year, crushing analyst estimates. Data center revenue hit $89 billion versus consensus of $85.7 billion. Non-GAAP EPS of $2.22 beat estimates of $2.06–$2.09. The company guided Q3 at $108 billion and CEO Jensen Huang forecast ~70% FY2028 revenue growth.
why: 英伟达财报为整个AI产业链定调：数据中心收入超预期意味着SK海力士HBM需求持续旺盛；黄仁勋的FY28增长展望支撑当前估值，有助于稳定AI板块情绪，并对Blackwell/Rubin架构相关持仓形成正面催化。

title: Alphabet Sheds $692B in Market Value Amid AI Brain-Drain and Competitive Fears
summary: Alphabet (GOOGL) lost $692 billion in market capitalization as investors questioned whether the company is losing its AI edge and top talent. Despite Q2 Google Cloud revenue surging 82% year-over-year, sentiment turned sharply negative on reports of accelerating talent departures.
why: 谷歌AI研发护城河受质疑，若Gemini竞争力持续走弱，其广告与云业务的长期增长叙事将承压。同时提示对持有科技龙头covered call时的downside风险需警惕。

title: CrowdStrike +20%, Okta +29%: AI Threat Surge Drives Blockbuster Cybersecurity Quarter
summary: CrowdStrike posted Q2 revenue of $1.47 billion (+25.8% YoY), raising full-year guidance, as AI-driven cybersecurity threats fueled enterprise demand. Okta reported revenue of $805 million (+11% YoY), with new AI products accounting for 30% of bookings. Both stocks surged to multi-month highs.
why: 网络安全需求因AI威胁激增而加速，验证了AI双刃剑叙事。CrowdStrike/Okta强劲的订阅续约率支持long-term价值；高隐含波动率环境下两股是sell-put候选标的。

title: 美股三指收涨：纳指涨1.57%；恒生指数结束三连跌，沪指低开
summary: 受英伟达财报带动，美股8月27日收盘：标普500涨0.72%至7731点，纳指涨1.57%至26541点，道指涨0.20%至53569点。8月28日亚洲开市，恒生指数涨79点（+0.3%）收25078点，结束三日连跌；沪指低开0.16%报3950点，市场等待沃什讲话。
why: 大盘在等待杰克逊霍尔信号，恒生指数本月累涨1.2%，连续四个月正收益。对港股持仓的covered call / sell-put均需关注今日沃什发言后的波动率变化。

title: Alibaba Completes HK$80B Share Placement to Fund Full-Stack AI Build-Out
summary: Alibaba Group completed its placement of 710 million new shares at HK$112.70 each on August 26, raising net proceeds of approximately HK$79.7 billion. About 60% (HK$47.9B) will fund global computing infrastructure; the remaining 40% (HK$31.9B) will build hyperscale AI data centers.
why: 配售完成后稀释了约2.5%股权，但AI基建投入规模反映管理层对通义千问/阿里云长期竞争力的高度押注。短期股价承压（配售前-10%），期权隐含波动率仍偏高，可观察sell-put机会。

title: PDD Q2 Revenue Misses Estimates; Temu MAU Falls 11% as EU DSA Compliance Plan Due Today
summary: PDD Holdings reported Q2 revenue of 112.36B yuan (+8% YoY), missing the 116.35B yuan consensus. Net income fell 12% to 27.2B yuan. Temu's global monthly active users shrank 11% to 467 million—the first annual decline in platform history—amid US tariffs and the end of duty-free treatment for low-value parcels. August 28 is the deadline for Temu to submit a compliance action plan to the EU under the Digital Services Act, with a €200M fine already imposed.
why: 收入与利润双弱，加之Temu出海增长见顶，PDD的长期增长逻辑受挑战。今日EU截止日若Temu提交不力，后续处罚可能加码。持仓者需评估基本面恶化对sell-put行权价的影响。

title: Haidilao H1 2026: Record Revenue 22.3B Yuan; Delivery +121%, Dividend +11.5%
summary: Haidilao International (6862.HK) reported first-half 2026 revenue of 22.34 billion yuan (+7.9% YoY), a record for any first half. Delivery revenue surged 121.2% to 2.05 billion yuan, becoming the second growth engine. Core operating profit rose 4.4% to 2.51 billion yuan. The board declared an interim dividend of HK$0.377 per share (+11.5% YoY). Shares rose more than 7% in Hong Kong on August 26.
why: 外卖业务爆发式增长（+121%）显示海底捞找到新增长曲线，核心利润稳健，中期分红提升彰显管理层信心。适合评估covered call写入时机（短期大涨后IV走高）。

title: Palantir's Maven AI System on Track for $1B ARR as Pentagon Seeks $2.3B for AI Programs
summary: William Blair analyst flagged Palantir's Maven Smart System as on track to reach $1 billion in annual recurring revenue, which would elevate it to program-of-record status. The Pentagon is separately seeking $2.3 billion for Maven and the Joint Fires Network. PLTR shares gained ~3% to reach $184.32 on August 27.
why: 国防AI政府合同持续扩大，若Maven达到B ARR里程碑，将锁定长期稳定收入。Palantir估值较高但政府合同壁垒深；适合评估现价附近sell-put的保护水位。

title: SK Hynix Showcases HBM4 at DTF 2026; Holds 50–55% HBM Market Share as Nvidia Rubin Ramps
summary: SK Hynix presented a full lineup of AI memory solutions at the Data Technology Forum (DTF) 2026 on August 26, including HBM4 and a 12-layer HBM4E sample. The company holds 50–55% of the global HBM market and is Nvidia's primary supplier. HBM4 is expected to be a key component of Nvidia's upcoming Rubin architecture.
why: HBM4展示确认SK海力士领先地位，Rubin架构量产前景支撑长期需求；若英伟达Q3财报继续超预期，HBM供应商受益。南方两倍做多SK海力士ETF波动率较高，需控制仓位。

title: 美团Q2 2026财报今日盘后发布，预期收入约1063亿元
summary: 美团（3690.HK）定于2026年8月28日港股收盘后发布二季度业绩，电话会同日港时19:00举行。分析师预期收入约1063.8亿元人民币。上季度（Q1）美团EPS超预期30%、股价当日涨16%，市场对此次财报期待较高。
why: 美团上季度外卖+即时零售业务强劲增长，若Q2延续，估值重估可能继续；Keeta出海进展亦值得关注。盘后波动率通常放大，期权仓位管理需注意Delta风险。

title: Marvell Q2 Revenue $2.74B Beats Estimates; Data Center +46%—But Stock Drops 7% After Hours
summary: Marvell Technology reported Q2 FY2027 revenue of $2.74 billion (beating consensus by 1.2%) with non-GAAP EPS of $0.94 (beat by 1.19%). Data center revenue, which accounts for 76% of total, grew 46% year-over-year. The company guided FY2027 revenue to ~$11.5 billion (+40% YoY) and FY2028 to ~$16.5 billion. Despite the beat, shares fell 7%+ in extended trading, reflecting high market expectations after a 175%+ year-to-date run.
why: 财报超预期但股价跌，典型买预期卖事实走势，提示AI基础设施热门股估值透支风险。与持仓SK海力士/英伟达逻辑联动：若AI算力订单不及预期上调，相关个股均有回调风险。
